semanticChecks.description: Current-state rows must not claim future platforms as implemented. Use current_state_or_target_state and future_target_flag explicitly.
Every loaded row must preserve source_file, source_date or as_of_date, confidence, and known_gaps where available.
Placeholder values such as TBD, unknown, sample, lorem ipsum, not_loaded, or owner to confirm do not count as valid facts.

columnContractWaivers.reason: This package predates enforcement and carries a generic governance schema (record_id/entity_id/business_name/context_item/dimension/evidence_id) instead of the per-dimension contract columns. 18 of 19 dimensions are affected, plus 2 filename drifts. Depth passes; shape does not. Contract fields carrying a value: 23%, against 99% for the packages generated to the contract.
columnContractWaivers.remediation: GATE-08 is decided: the column contract is authoritative and this package is remediated to it (see the GATE-08 Decision section in docs/governance/TENANT_CONTEXT_SINGLE_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH_REDO_PLAN_2026-08-12.md). Add the contract columns alongside the existing governance columns and populate them from deterministic sources only; leave the rest empty and raise evidence requests. Then remove this waiver. Regenerating the package and repointing any active root remain GATE-02 and need scoped approval.
